explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. I did not search Mathlib, because the statement only makes sense in terms of the library's own definitions: `ConvexPolygon`, `SidePairing`, `cycleMap` and `P.vertex`, and probably the predicate `Γ.IsCuspPoint` too, though I did not check that one. Mathlib has no theory of convex hyperbolic polygons or of side pairings, so it cannot state a result about the cycle map of a side pairing. The proof combines three of the library's own lemmas: `Subgroup.isCuspPoint_iff_exists_mem_stabilizer_isParabolic`, `cycleMap_smul_eq_self_of_vertex_eq_inr` and `isParabolic_cycleMap_of_locallyFinite`. The mathematical content lies in those lemmas, not in any Mathlib declaration.
